I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. The official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was 3-Nov-2025.

Two sources give that date:
- **Moss's Coastal digest of 2-Nov-2025:** it says ownership changes hands "tomorrow".
- **Bettina's own cutover recap of 8-Dec-2025:** it also calls November 3 the official handoff.

The recap adds that Bettina kept running the account day to day until 21-Nov-2025 and Kwame fully took over on 22-Nov-2025. I gave her both dates and said which one fits which tracker field.

I wrote all dates as day-month-year with dashes, as she asked in her DM.
